exposure: timing of death (postpartum, within 12 hours of admission)
cohort: Mothers who died in a large hospital in Baghdad between February 2011 and February 2018.
finding: Maternal mortality was high (58.12 per 105,000 live births) and obstetrical hemorrhage was the main cause of death.
mod_finding: The majority of deceased mothers underwent cesarean section (P = 0.0184).
